name: Calm Explorer
tagline: Slow down, breathe in nature, and find peaceful moments
description: You love serene landscapes, quiet walking trails, lush gardens, and unhurried days away from city hustle.

name: Festival Spark
tagline: Feel the pulse of music, crowds, and celebration
description: You thrive on joyful street carnivals, vibrant colours, rhythmic drums, ringing temple bells, and unforgettable energy.

name: Adventure Seeker
tagline: High hills, scenic trails, and fresh mountain breezes
description: You are drawn to active ridge hikes, valley vistas, forest scrambles, and high-altitude excitement.

name: Foodie Wanderer
tagline: Taste authentic recipes, street bites, and aromatic spices
description: Steaming buff and veg momos, sweet sel roti, secret courtyard eateries, and cooking workshops guide your journey.

name: Spiritual Seeker
tagline: Ancient stupas, chanting monks, and soul-calming rituals
description: You seek peace among butter lamps, spinning brass prayer wheels, sacred riversides, and meditative hilltop shrines.

name: Heritage Historian
tagline: Intricate woodwork, medieval palace squares, and stone tales
description: You love diving into ancient Malla-dynasty courtyards, living stone carvings, timeless pagoda temples, and historic quarters.

name: Creative Soul
tagline: Artisan craft workshops, pottery wheels, and vibrant alleys
description: You want to watch master artisans paint delicate thangkas, shape clay pots, weave hemp, and sketch secret courtyards.

name: Family Fun
tagline: Gentle pacing, joyful sights, and comfortable shared memories
description: Balanced, scenic, and approachable outings with green park strolls, cable car rides, delicious sweet shops, and easy logistics.
